summary.text: Heidi Balderree is a Republican member of the Utah Senate representing District 22 in Salt Lake and Utah counties and has served since October 17, 2023. She sits on the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Judiciary, Law Enforcement, and Criminal Justice Committee.

paragraphs.text: Balderree holds a bachelor's degree in anthropology from Brigham Young University and a master's in human resource management from the Keller Graduate School of Management.
